lines.text: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
But their famous pink? It isn't really theirs.
Flamingo chicks hatch fluffy, white and gray.
The pink comes from their food: algae and tiny brine shrimp.
They're packed with natural pigments called carotenoids.
And they eat upside down, filtering water through their bills.
It takes several years of that diet to turn fully pink.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
